messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy finished: canary rollout for inference-proxy v2.3.1 -> 10% at 09:12 UTC

maria: seeing p95 -> 1.8s, p99 -> 6.2s, 5xx rate up 3.9x since 09:13. Lots of gateway 502 / timeout traces.

cheng: which path is spiking? proxy or runtime?

maria: proxy fanout to backend-embed and backend-gen. backend-gen 95th went from 200ms -> 1.5s, but proxy p99 is 6s, lots of context-switch waits.

dave: paging in, taking oncall. @maria can you pin the canary? If it's still rolling up we should halt.

maria: halting rollout now. running: `redwood deploy set-weight inference-proxy v2.3.1 0`

deploy-bot: Rollout weight set -> v2.3.1 = 0%, stable v2.2.8 = 100% (cmd by maria)

maria: rollback initiated, errors dropping in dashboard already: 5xx down ~65% from peak. Keep monitoring.

ops-rc: quick mitigation: routing rule reverted. Also temporarily enabled fallback-model-route to small-quant to reduce backend-gen latency in case of surges.

support-bot: alert created in customer-support channel for customers with >1% error impact. cc: @product-ops

cheng: grabbing logs from proxy nodes. seeing increased `epoll_wait` latency + thread-pool queueing on canary nodes. Kernel config note: `net.core.somaxconn` unchanged. Not a socket backlog at first glance.

maria: can you paste a small log snippet?

cheng: ```
[09:13:21] proxy-node-7 | request id=abc123 latency=6020ms upstream=502 fanout=[gen:6010ms, embed:18ms] thread_wait=79ms
[09:13:22] proxy-node-8 | request id=def456 latency=5901ms upstream=504 fanout=[gen:5885ms, embed:21ms]
```

dave: looks like backend-gen on canary instances had KV cache miss storms + CPU steal. Could be a model init jitter under that build. Any config changes in v2.3.1?

maria: v2.3.1 included the new `kvcache-prefetch` opt and updated libtorch pinned to 2.1. Small change but timing matches.

cheng: rolling logs show model load spikes on new instances at first requests, and fanout keeps them busy. That would blow up p99 at the proxy.

dave: good rollback. we should cordon canary instances and repro in staging. For live, keep fallback-model-route and lowered canary weight. I'll start an incident doc.

maria: customer impact calc from 09:12-09:20: ~0.8% of traffic affected, peak affected requests ~820rps -> ~3500 errors, top customers: two enterprise customers saw brief elevated errors. Ops emailed support.

support-bot: support case #INC-4281 created and enriched with telemetry links.

ops-rc: we also disabled `kvcache-prefetch` via runtime flag on canary hosts to test if it's the trigger. If staging repro confirms, we'll cut a hotfix.

cheng: starting memory/cold-start analysis and will circle back with a small repro and timeline.

maria: handoff to SRE/infra for post-rollback checks — @dave @cheng you own the next 2h. I'll close the oncall window unless anything else flares.

dave: taking it. adding notes to incident doc with timeline and commands used.

maria: tl;dr: canary v2.3.1 introduced a kvcache-prefetch change that appears to cause backend-gen init stalls under production fanout patterns -> proxy p99/timeouts -> rollback successful, mitigating actions applied. Postmortem next steps: slot staging repro, revert prefetch default in builder, add canary health gating for fanout latency. :white_check_mark:

cheng: will attach logs and perf flamegraphs to the incident doc.

support-bot: notifying affected customers summary prepared.

maria: final status: rollback completed, services stable at 09:18 UTC, monitoring in watch for 60m. handing off to SRE.

dave: closing active page. will update with RCA draft later today.
